cards.card_text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses: take the blasphemer outside the camp, and the whole assembly is to stone him.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take the blasphemer outside the camp, and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head; then have the whole assembly stone him.

cards.card_text: Before the stoning, who does the LORD say is to lay their hands on the blasphemer's head?
cards.verse_text: “Take the blasphemer outside the camp, and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head; then have the whole assembly stone him.

cards.card_text: Then Moses speaks to the Israelites, and they take the blasphemer outside the camp and stone him.
cards.verse_text: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him.

cards.card_text: Paul doesn't hide his past: he says he was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor and a violent man.
cards.verse_text: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
